title: Veteran Airline Pilot Claims He's Seen UFOs He Can't Explain On Numerous Flights And Has Video to Prove It

content:
A commercial airline pilot with nearly 30 years of experience says he has repeatedly seen UFOs while flying over Europe. He says he has video of what he witnessed, unlike many others who have made similar claims.

Steve Frazer, 48, from Cheshire, England, says he has seen strange lights in the sky that he cannot identify on six or seven separate flights since 2022.

His most recent reported sighting was in October, near Brussels, Belgium. Frazer initially thought the lights were a distant military aircraft, the Daily Express reports. Then he saw how they were moving.

“I just thought it was a military refueling aircraft, but the way it was moving and [its] speed, it didn’t make any sense,” Frazer said. “We were going towards them for seemingly ages and never got to them.”

Pilot Says UFOs Were Unlike Anything He’s Seen In 27 Years Of Flying

The mysterious UFOs appeared as bright orbs (yes, again) moving across the sky, then suddenly vanished, Frazer says. He says another pilot saw similar lights on his return from Lithuania.

“We saw them in the same space and roughly the same direction, but it was ever so strange,” he said.

What’s particularly strange about the sightings, Frazer says, is that the objects seemed to stay at a distance even as his plane moved toward them.

“I’ve been flying 27 years commercially, and it doesn’t fit with anything I’ve seen previously,” he said.

A video he recorded shows several bright lights moving across the sky before disappearing.

Frazer considered the possibility that the lights were satellites, including those from Elon Musk’s Starlink network.

“I know what satellites normally look like; I’ve seen plenty of Starlinks and things like that,” he explained. “They don’t fit with that movement.”

Other Airline Pilots Have Also Recently Reported Strange UFO Encounters

Steve Frazer is not the only seasoned pilot who has seen something in the sky recently that he cannot explain. A British Airways commercial jet recently reported having a close encounter with a UFO flying over England.

In another incident, two pilots flying over Ohio at 41,000 feet photographed a mysterious metallic, pill-shaped UFO. The object reportedly wasn’t visible on air traffic control radar or the plane’s collision-avoidance system.

Frazer, for his part, isn’t saying aliens are buzzing around over Belgium. He just knows whatever he saw wasn’t something he recognized.

“Technically, in a sense, it’s an unidentified object that seems to be flying,” he said.

After 27 years in the cockpit, one would certainly think that he knows pretty well what belongs up there and what doesn’t.
